text:
Ivy: Hey finance team — saw a corp card auto-debit for a recurring hotel membership (HotelClub Pro) of $129.99. The vendor invoice shows $0 (trial) but the card was charged. Cardholder says they never activated membership. Anyone seen this pattern?
Marcus: We've seen a few cases where a trial converts automatically. Corporate card portal should block subscriptions but sometimes vendors hide the toggle. Does charge match vendor descriptor?
Ivy: Descriptor is HOTELCLUB*MGMT, transaction id txn_78b3. Card statement line posted on 2024-07-02. No invoice attached in Concur.
Samir: If there's no invoice, treat as disputed/unapproved spend. Ask cardholder to request refund from vendor; finance can start a dispute with the bank. Collect screenshot of vendor account showing no active subscription.
Nora: For policy: subscriptions require manager approval in advance and proof of business need. If the employee didn't get approval, typically the cost is the employee's responsibility unless manager approves exception. Who approved travel or procurement?
Ivy: I didn't request approval — I was testing a promo last month for a hotel booking flow. Marcus — can Finance open a dispute?
Marcus: Opening a dispute needs cardholder confirmation and a bank dispute form. We also need a short note in Concur: "Unauthorized subscription charge; dispute opened" plus vendor communication attempts.
expense-bot: Flag: corporate card merchant is flagged for recurring subscriptions. Policy note: any recurring charge on corp card requires pre-approval; otherwise finance will seek reimbursement from cardholder if dispute fails.
Ivy: OK I'll DM vendor support and paste screenshots here. If vendor refuses refund can payroll deduct? I can't front it.
Samir: If employee is unable to refund, manager can authorize exception. Otherwise payroll deduction is last resort and requires signed consent: "I authorize payroll deduction for charge HOTELCLUB txn_78b3". We'll try dispute first.
Ivy: Pasted vendor chat screenshot: vendor says trial auto-renewed due to missed cancellation; offered partial pro-rata refund of $40.
Marcus: Good evidence. Start bank dispute: we need the card statement, vendor chat, and a signed employee note saying they didn't intentionally subscribe. I'll prepare the dispute packet. Expected timeline ~30-60 days.
Nora: Manager please comment on exception authority if dispute fails. @Samir are you manager?
Samir: I can approve up to $150 for one-off mistakes as a manager. If dispute fails, I'm ok to authorize absorbing this cost once and mark as EXC-SUB-2024-07-01. Please log rationale in Concur.
Ivy: Thanks Samir — I authorize dispute submission and will accept manager exception if needed.
Marcus: Filed dispute with bank (ref DB-2024-07-HC-78B3). Uploaded card statement and vendor chat to ticket. Concur note: "Unauthorized auto-renew charge; dispute filed; manager Samir pre-approved exception if dispute denied."
expense-bot: Action logged and reminder: recurring vendor blockers being added to corp-card blocked-merchants list for 7 days while investigation open.
Nora: Can we add a short line to corp-card guidance: "Never use corporate card for trials/subscriptions without procurement sign-off" — saves these headaches.
Samir: Agreed. @Marcus can you add to policy-drafts?
Marcus: Will draft and post to #policy for review. Closing thread once dispute resolved or refund issued.
expense-bot: Reminder: close ticket by updating Concur reimbursement status when dispute completes."
